import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/leaderboard/popularity/like/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { resolveTargetUidFromArg } from '@src/utils/targetUid';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { Format, onResponse, useMention } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const [mention] = useMention();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const match = text.match(/点赞人气\s+(\S+)\s+([A-Za-z]+)/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  const targetUid = await resolveTargetUidFromArg(match[1], mention);
  const boardType = match[2];

  if (!targetUid) {
    return;
  }

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, uid, bid, targetUid, boardType, request });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '人气点赞',
        header: [{ label: '人气榜', command: '/人气排行榜' }],
        content: md
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

  md.addText(displayMsg);

  if (result.data.success) {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`当前人气：${result.data.currentPopularity ?? 0}`);

    addOptions(md, [{ label: '✛1', command: text }]);

    md.addText(`今日剩余点赞：${result.data.remainingLikes ?? 0}次`);
  }

  const header = [{ label: '人气榜', command: '/人气排行榜' }];
  const boardLabel = result.data.boardLabel;

  if (boardLabel) {
    header.push({ label: `${boardLabel} `, command: `/${boardLabel}` });
  }

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '人气点赞', content: md, header }));
});
